# ggml is usually included by stable-diffusion.cpp and vision.cpp
# If they need to share it, we might need to add it here, but typically they use their own submodules.
# For now we'll just add the main projects.

if(VLLAMA_CUDA)
    set(SD_CUDA ON CACHE BOOL "Enable CUDA in stable-diffusion.cpp" FORCE)
    set(GGML_CUDA ON CACHE BOOL "Enable CUDA in ggml" FORCE)
endif()

add_subdirectory(vision.cpp)
add_subdirectory(stable-diffusion.cpp)

# Header-only libraries
add_library(cpp-httplib INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(cpp-httplib INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/cpp-httplib)

add_library(nlohmann_json INTERFACE)
target_include_directories(nlohmann_json INTERFACE ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/nlohmann_json/include)
